🚧 Heads up, #IndianWells: Traffic advisory on Miles Avenue and Washington Street 🚧

As part of ongoing improvements to the Miles Avenue and Washington Street intersection, traffic changes will take place starting this week to keep our community and crews safe:

🔹 Miles Avenue (Westbound): One lane open
🔹 Washington Street (Southbound): Two lanes open

📅 With school starting on August 20, please drive with extra caution and allow ample time for travel.

Stay informed:
📲 Text 92210 to 888777 to get Nixle alerts
🔗 Visit https://t.co/X3mLFRiZle for updates

Thank you for your patience as we work to improve our City’s infrastructure! 🙌
